title: Resolution of compact Einstein orbifolds in general dimensions
summary: Given a noncollapsing sequence of $m$-dimensional compact Einstein manifolds with a uniform energy bound, the Gromov-Hausdorff limit is a compact Einstein orbifold with at most finitely many singularities. Conversely, starting with a compact Einstein orbifold, we are interested in whether there exists a sequence of smooth Einstein metrics converging to it. In this paper, we provide a negative answer.
